{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
deduplicated = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now verify: we should have 800 rows (one per patient)
print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {len(deduplicated)}')

# Check the assay_batch unit issue: batch-B values are in µg/L, not ng/mL
# So we must divide batch-B biomarker_final by 10 to convert to ng/mL
# Batch A is already in ng/mL

deduplicated['biomarker_final_corrected'] = deduplicated['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = deduplicated['assay_batch'] == 'B'
deduplicated.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_corrected'] = deduplicated.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Now compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = deduplicated['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (corrected to ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}')

# Output the result
mean_biomarker_final"}
